description: This file defines the DatabaseBackend class implementing cache storage using Drupal's database system, including methods for cache retrieval, storage, invalidation, and schema management.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Cache\DatabaseBackend
classes.description: Implements cache backend using database tables, managing cache data, invalidation, and schema.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DatabaseBackend with database connection, cache bin, serializer, time service, and max rows.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by cache ID.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache items by their IDs.

methods.name: prepareItem
methods.description: Prepares and validates a cache item, unserializing data if valid.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a cache item with given ID, data, expiration, and tags.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Stores multiple cache items in batch.

methods.name: doSetMultiple
methods.description: Performs the actual database insert/update for multiple cache items.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cache item by ID.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache items by their IDs.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all cache entries in the bin.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache item by ID.

methods.name: invalidateMultiple
methods.description: Invalidates multiple cache items by their IDs.

methods.name: invalidateAll
methods.description: Invalidates all cache entries (deprecated, use deleteAll).

methods.name: garbageCollection
methods.description: Performs cleanup of expired or excess cache entries.

methods.name: removeBin
methods.description: Drops the cache table from the database.

methods.name: ensureBinExists
methods.description: Checks if cache table exists, creates it if not.

methods.name: catchException
methods.description: Handles exceptions, rethrowing if the table exists.

methods.name: normalizeCid
methods.description: Normalizes cache ID to comply with database limitations.

methods.name: schemaDefinition
methods.description: Defines the database schema for cache tables.

methods.name: getMaxRows
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of rows allowed in the cache table.
